symptom: lease tick read returned no authority_fences row and raised KeyError for the configured target
correlation: both failures occurred when the WAL was checkpointed into the main database after sustained concurrent heartbeat writes and lease reads
fix: serialize critical fence and identity reads with the same process writer lock and make repeated identical state transitions no-op
invariants: critical fence read cannot interleave with a write or auto-checkpoint on the shared connection
repeated CENTRAL_SUSPECT ticks do not append duplicate transitions
